candidates.store: store 4552038, trade name not exposed on the page
candidates.notes: Authenticity check on gallery images 1 and 2. Image 1 shows front and back: RF can etched Ra-01SH-P over Ai-Thinker, ISM:803-930MHz, PA:+29dBm, LoRa/(G)FSK, with an IPEX connector, and the reverse silkscreen gives the full pinout GND NSS MOSI MISO SCK RF_EN BUSY GND on one side and ANT GND 3V3 RESET VCCPA DIO1 DIO2 DIO3 on the other, with Ra-01SCH-P printed down the middle. Image 2 confirms the same etching in three-quarter view. Genuine Ai-Thinker, but the dash P is the high-power build at plus 29 dBm with a separate VCCPA supply rail, not the plain plus 22 dBm Ra-01SH the spec names, and the extra PA changes the current draw on a solar node. The published pinout on the back is a real advantage for wiring. Take this if a guaranteed free-shipping price and a legible pinout matter more than matching the part exactly, but expect to feed VCCPA.

candidates.price_note: Free shipping on the card, so landed 420, but the price shown is for whichever variant is default across a very wide dropdown.
candidates.notes: Rejected on wrong-part risk. One listing covers Ra-01, Ra-01S, Ra-01H, Ra-01SC and Ra-01SH across 433 and 868 MHz, and mixes SX1262 with LLCC68 silicon and SPI with UART interfaces in the same dropdown. LLCC68 is explicitly excluded by the spec, 433 MHz is the wrong band, and no rating or review count was exposed, so there is no way to be sure which part arrives. Not worth 420 KES of risk when the chosen listing sells the exact part for less.
